description: Answers of the command bar's agent in markdown, as the server stores them, with the issues and project documents they link and the text the bar draws of each answer. The bar draws an answer with chips (MarkdownBody with chips in packages/dispatch/web/src/features/refs/MarkdownBody.tsx): the first link to each issue, a time link whose words are the issue's key included, is the issue's chip, its key, its status and its title (ItemChip, whose status a screen reader reads); a later link to the same issue keeps the words it was written with (takeIssueLinks); a link to another item, such as an issue's spec or a project document, is its own words where they are not its address, and the item's name where they are (RefLink); a time link shows its words with its instant on hover, and its words alone where its address names no instant (dispatch-time.tsx); and an issue the store does not hold draws as its bare key. Written by hand from the bar's rules, not from either side's code. In Go, chips.RenderAnswer (packages/envoy/going/chips/render.go) writes each chip and each address-worded item name in square brackets and each hover date in UTC; render_test.go holds RenderAnswer to rendered verbatim, and MarkdownBody.rendered-answers.test.tsx holds the drawn DOM to rendered after verifying each actual hover date against its instant and dropping RenderAnswer's structural square brackets.
